# Legacy embedding smoke fixture

`legacy_embeddings.jsonl` is generated by
`../generate_legacy_embeddings.py`. Its vectors are deterministic constant,
unit-normalized test data; they are not derived from a person or an image.
The generator reads `../../../legacy-compatibility.manifest.json`, which is
cross-checked against `../../../models.manifest.json`; it does not carry a
second hard-coded recognizer contract.

Regenerate from the `FaceFeatureExtractorAPI` directory with:

```powershell
.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe tests\fixtures\generate_legacy_embeddings.py
```

The three records deliberately exercise `compatible`, `requires_reextract`,
and `invalid` report groups.
